title: Canonical Quantisation of Bound and Unbound WQFT
abstract: Derives a version of the Worldline Quantum Field Theory (WQFT) formalism suitable for both scattering and bound configurations of the classical two-body problem using canonical quantisation. Focuses on charged particles interacting via scalar field, quantising Hamilton's equations in flat space and around backgrounds via post-Lorentzian and self-force expansions. Provides gauge-invariant matrix elements for 1SF scattering dynamics up to 3PL order.
key_claims: Canonical quantization bypasses worldline path integrals
Unified framework for conservative and radiative binary dynamics
Applicable to both scattering (infinite time) and bound orbits (finite time)
Complete 1SF scattering matrix elements to 3PL order
